headlines.title: Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Rallies On GTA VI Buzz, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) is back in focus after its latest earnings release and a fresh outlook tied to Grand Theft Auto VI. Investors are weighing softer recent results against management’s guidance for a potentially historic fiscal 2027. Over the past few sessions, Take-Two Interactive Software has moved sharply higher, with a 1-day share price return of 2.97% and a 7-day share price return of 10.

headlines.title: GTA VI Is Days Away: Don't Expect GTA V-Style Returns From Take-Two Stock at 5.7 Times Sales
headlines.summary: GTA V made Take-Two investors a fortune, but the price of admission this time is very different.

headlines.title: JPMorgan names top Mid & Small Cap stock pick
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan has identified its top stock pick in the mid and small cap sector, highlighting Take-Two Interactive Software as its leading choice as the gaming company prepares for the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI console release.

headlines.title: Take-Two's Zelnick on Success of the GTA Franchise
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick talks about the highly anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI, out next week. He says the Grand Theft Auto franchise "is probably the most valuable intellectual property in the entertainment business" because of its enormous global reach. Zelnick sits down with David Rubenstein on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded October 19 in New York.

headlines.title: Take-Two CEO sends strong message to investors ahead of GTA 6
headlines.summary: Take-Two’s soft quarter didn’t shake its chief. Bank of America set a bar for launch weekend and sees GTA’s long-term payday arriving later than hoped.

description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille 3, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Hit It Rich!, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Wizard Of Oz Slots Casino, Toy Blast, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and Color Block Jam. The company's products are designed for console gaming systems; and mobiles, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. It provides its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New York, New York.
